kicker: From one flat photo, AI sculpts a koi that can swim.

pipeline.label: Six steps to a shape
pipeline.aria: A 3D koi model. Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate it.
pipeline.orText: or: “red and white koi, long fins”
pipeline.back: Back side: not in the photo

steps.name: Photo or text
steps.caption: You give it a photo or a short description. A photo is flat: one side only.

steps.name: Many views (multi-view)
steps.caption: AI guesses the object from the front, back, top and sides — even parts the photo doesn’t show.

steps.name: Build the shape (mesh)
steps.caption: The views join into a 3D shape: a shell made of many tiny triangles.

steps.name: Add materials (texture, PBR)
steps.caption: Texture is the image wrapped around it; PBR adds roughness and bumps so light looks real.

steps.name: Clean mesh, add bones
steps.caption: Retopology: tidy a messy mesh into a clean one. Rig: add a skeleton so it can move.

steps.name: Put it to use
steps.caption: Export a 3D file: keep editing in Blender, drop it into a game, or view it in AR.

note.text: Blender: free, open-source 3D software for refining the model.

items.name: Game
items.note: In a game: a clean mesh with bones, so the fish can swim.

items.name: AR
items.note: AR (augmented reality): the fish appears on a real table through your phone camera.

pipeline.insight: AI builds 3D like an assembly line: guess the views, shape the form, add materials, then tidy up for use.
pipeline.detail: What the photo doesn’t show, AI must guess — so the back is sometimes wrong. A 3D artist still needs to check.
pipeline.noWebgl: Still image: six steps turn a koi photo into a 3D model.

splats.label: Sprinkled from real photos
splats.title: A sibling technique
splats.aria: A stone lantern built from soft, blurry dabs of color. Drag or use the arrow keys to walk around it.
splats.shutter: Take a photo from this angle

insight.text: Gaussian splatting builds 3D from many real photos taken around an object: countless soft dabs of color layered together.

splats.detail: Unlike AI 3D generation, splats only record what was photographed. Any angle not shot stays blurry or empty.
splats.noWebgl: Still image: a stone lantern emerges from soft dabs of color, pieced together from many photos around it.

input.label: A good input photo
input.insight: A good photo for 3D AI: clean, clear, shot head-on, plain background, nothing cut off.

detail.text: The AI’s version usually still needs fixing in Blender (3D modeling software) before real use.

input.noWebgl: Still image: a clear, head-on photo on a plain background gives a cleaner 3D result.

models.label: The 3D workshops
models.insight: Each tool shines in its own way. Try a few with the same photo, then compare the results.
models.detail: The strengths noted here are general opinions; AI changes weekly, so they may be out of date.

quiz.q: Why should a photo for 3D AI be clear, head-on and show the whole object?
options: So AI has less hidden stuff to guess
quiz.explain: AI must guess whatever the photo doesn’t show; the clearer and fuller the photo, the fewer wrong guesses.

summary: 3D AI guesses hidden sides, shapes the form, adds materials — people still tidy up.
